title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: monotonicallyIncreasing
text:
monotonically increasing
monotonically increasing
(definition)
Definition:
A
function
from a
partially ordered
domain
to a partially ordered
range
such that x ≤ y implies f(x) ≤ f(y).
See also
monotonically decreasing
,
strictly increasing
.
Note:
After
[CLR90, page 32]
.

PEB
